objective: Turn existing DreamLedger substrate into many bounded money experiments without creating a new commerce architecture.

source_roles.GitHub: implementation, workers, public offers, surfaces, proof contracts
source_roles.Notion: candidate history, demand hypotheses, market evidence, constraints
source_roles.Airtable: economic opportunities, offer inventory, operational state, telemetry

generation.unit: substrate fragment × demand family × reusable transformation
generation.test_rule: UNTESTED is not FAILED; FAILED is not permanently DEAD

reuse_rule: Prefer an existing worker, existing Stripe boundary, existing entitlement/toll road, existing fulfillment path, existing evidence packet, and existing public surface. A new primitive requires a measured blocker.
economic_gate: No internal computation, checkout start, database row, model output, or payment link counts as revenue.
factory_direction: Many substrate fragments in; many bounded candidate transformations out; existing commerce spine tests them; verified payment and fulfillment determine which transformations replicate.
